Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Phase 7: this is the only failing file left (yarn test:app: 1 file, 6 tests failed; everything else passes). The App.tsx, Scene.ts and history.ts fixes from the senior review are now on disk. Failures as the file is on disk, verbatim: `AC-1 ... expected 1 to be 2` (line 42), `AC-2 ... expected +0 to be 100`, `AC-3 ... expected 'Page 2' to be 'SDK flow'`, `AC-4: isolates undo history per page: expected [ 'rect2' ] to deeply equal []`, `AC-5 ... TypeError: (0 , exportToSvg) is not a function`, `AC-7 ... expected 'id30' to be 'page-1'`; yarn test:typecheck `pages.test.tsx(6,10): error TS2459: Module '"../scene/export"' declares 'exportToSvg' locally, but it is not exported.`; yarn test:code prettier at 195:12 and 196:12 (wrap `{ ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id: "a1" }), pageId: "a" }` one property per line with trailing comma; same for b1/"b"). Fix all of these in the test, keeping every assertion: (1) render `<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />` (as history.test.tsx does) so Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.Z) / KEYS.A reach the app - without it undo() and select-all never run, which is why AC-4 still saw rect2; (2) wrap every direct h.app.addPage/switchPage/renamePage/reorderPages/deletePage and h.setState call in `act(() => { ... })` from ./test-utils, capturing return values; (3) replace exportToSvg with the exported `exportScene({ type: "svg", ... })` from ../scene/export as export.test.ts does, and serialize all pages via h.app.getAllSceneElements(); (4) in AC-7 mock `window.HTMLElement.prototype.scrollIntoView = vi.fn()` before opening search (search.test.tsx does this; earlier attempts hit `TypeError: ref?.scrollIntoView is not a function`).

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
